title: Transmission X-Ray · An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Scan the closed case
scenes.purpose: A closed case is scanned left to right, revealing the layered density image of an idea connected to its system.
visuals: View A panel at 0°: closed textured case
Teal scan beam sweeps x 150→692 px
Transmission layers revealed behind the beam: shell, links, idea core, nodes

beats.development: Scan beam appears and sweeps across the closed case; the density image replaces the opaque exterior behind it.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Scan completes; a teal crosshair ring draws around the idea core to select the interior feature.

scenes.title: Isolate and rotate the scan
scenes.purpose: The isolated scan is rotated 90° about the same model transform to show the idea core's depth.
visuals: Dashed landmark line from View A crosshair to View B
View B shows the same 3D model projected at θ 0°→90°
Depth axis with core marker; feature label

beats.development: Isolated scan appears in View B at the matching 0° orientation, linked by a dashed landmark line.
View B rotates 0°→90°; nodes spread by depth while the crosshaired core stays traceable; angle label counts up.
Feature label resolves; both views hold with shared landmarks for comparison.

findings: Scan, select, isolate and rotate run back-to-back with no dead time; composition is settled by 2.6 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.45–3.0 s final hold lets viewers reconcile the two orientations and read the feature label.

notes: Density values are simulated for illustration, not measured scan data.
